[[Mallyx's Savagery]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest|Citadel chest]] that spawns after defeating [[Mallyx the Unyielding]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Banana Scythe]]. (see below)

==Trivia==
*The fact that this weapon has the skin of a banana scythe and it is called Mallyx's "Savagery" is most likely because Mallyx resembles a gorilla and his mini pet acts like a gorilla.
